- Name: CWI x402 API (slug: cwi-x402)
- Version: 0.1.0 | Lineage: R1/R3 | Stage: packaged

## What it is

Usage-metered HTTP API surface: pay-per-call pricing ($0.05-$0.25 USDC on Base for paid routes) with staged rates, no seats, no setup fee; sandbox mode for safe testing.

## Intended use

Agents needing a deterministic paid-call API with receipts chained per call.

## Capabilities

- free discovery tier
- per-call metering with production-format receipts
- CWI-Version 2026-10-01 date pin
- sandbox test mode (2/10 routes)

## Honest limitations

Mainnet is NOT live: paid rates staged, pending founder approval; mainnet extension beyond sandbox requires Lansky's tap.
